learning_objective: 🎯 Today we will become builders and use special super glue words to stick short sentences together!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Conjunctions are joining words! They act like super glue to stick words, groups of words, or short sentences together to make one big sentence.
We use AND to join similar ideas together (I like apples and bananas). We use BUT to join different or opposite ideas (I like apples but I do not like grapes).
We use OR when we have to make a choice (Do you want tea or milk?). We use BECAUSE when we want to give a reason for something (I am smiling because I am happy).

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Sentence Train Match!
fun_activity.instructions: Write 'I was tired' on one paper and 'I went to sleep' on another. Now, write 'because' on a third paper and put it in the middle to join your train cars together!

quick_recap: ⭐ And joins similar ideas, But joins opposite ideas.
⭐ Because gives a reason for something.
